body:
incident-bot: Paging: High 5xx rate observed in Dedicated EU GPU pool affecting customer Cygnus (account: cygnus-enterprise). Auto-snooze 5m. Severity: P1.

sre-oncall-ben: ack — I'm on it. Spinning up debug runbooks. First check: autoscaler logs, qps, and recent deploys.

ops-lead-carla: Jamila FYI — Cygnus contacts need to be notified if this is >30m. Do we have current POC list?

acct-jamila: I have their escalation list in LastPass but will copy core contacts here once we confirm impact. Primary: ops@cygnus.com (on-call), sec: eng-leads.

support-luke: seeing increased error spikes on our support dashboard, multiple duplicate reports from the customer portal. Ticket #CYG-512 opened.

eng-runtime-maya: repro steps from logs: request latency increases followed by 502s from runtime shards 7-9. Kernel trace shows KV cache thrash on longer-context requests.

sre-oncall-ben: taking runtime shard 7. Running hotfix: rollback recent runtime patch on eu-dedicated pool to stable v1.4.2. Command: `rdwctl rollout cancel --pool eu-dedicated --version v1.5.0`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout cancel issued by ben at 14:12 UTC. Job #3219 queued.

eng-runtime-maya: confirming: patch v1.5.0 introduced a batching change that can increase cache churn for >8k token sessions. Looks correlated with Cygnus workload.

sre-oncall-ben: telemetry: 5xx rate down from 18% -> 6% after cancel queued, still higher than baseline 0.5%. Continuing investigation, will escalate to infra if not back to baseline in 10m.

ops-lead-carla: Drafting status page text (short): "We are investigating increased errors for Cygnus on Dedicated EU; mitigation in progress. Impact: request failures and degraded throughput for some enterprise customers. ETA: 30m. More updates every 15m." Thoughts?

acct-jamila: Suggest adding tailored impact for Cygnus in the customer email: mention their nightly batch jobs may have failed and we will re-run or provide guidance. Also include their POC names and a direct Slack bridge offer.

support-luke: add contact routing note: for Cygnus, page engineering only for SEV1; otherwise route to account team first. Add `#enterprise-cygnus` channel mention.

docs-ryan: I'll prepare the status page and customer email template. Draft email (short):
```
Subject: [Redwood] Incident affecting Cygnus — Dedicated EU
Hi team — we detected an elevated error rate impacting request processing in your Dedicated EU pool beginning ~14:05 UTC. We are actively mitigating (rollback in progress) and will send updates every 15 minutes. If you need immediate assistance, please reply here or use the on-call contact: ops@cygnus.com. Apologies for the disruption — Redwood Support
```

eng-runtime-maya: rollback completed at 14:22 UTC, runtime shards stabilized. We're seeing error rate down to ~1.2% and latency returning to baseline for small sessions. Longer-context sessions still showing elevated errors on shard 9.

sre-oncall-ben: I'm switching to 15min monitoring window. Reassigning follow-up: can eng-runtime run a targeted cache warm on shard 9 and schedule a controlled restart if needed?

eng-runtime-maya: will run `kvcache-warm --shard 9 --pool eu-dedicated --prefetch=5000` now, then monitor for 10m.

incident-bot: monitor-bot: KV warm job started (job 778).

acct-jamila: I pushed the customer email draft to the queue and started a private thread with Cygnus account contacts. Sent initial heads-up via existing escalation Slack DM.

sre-oncall-ben: handoff to night on-call at 15:00 UTC (threaded notes: rollback done, KV warm in progress, error rate trending down but not fully resolved). @ops-lead-carla — you're primary for customer comms during the handoff window.

ops-lead-carla: ack. I'll coordinate status page and the tailored email with Jamila. Also prepping internal comms template for execs: short impact, timeline, mitigation, next steps.

support-luke: updating ticket CYG-512 with timeline and included logs + fix steps. Adding customer-facing note that we will re-run any failed nightly jobs if requested.

eng-runtime-maya: KV warm complete at 14:35 UTC. Error rate steady ~0.4%. Shard 9 stable during 10m window.

sre-oncall-ben: closing active page at 14:40 UTC — mitigation successful. Leaving follow-ups: postmortem, model of test to prevent batching regression, add guard for automatic rollback when 5xx > 5% for 5m.

ops-lead-carla: internal exec comms (brief): "Incident: Cygnus Dedicated EU — transient runtime regression after v1.5.0 rollout causing elevated 5xx rates; rollback and cache warm restored service. Impact: failed requests and potential failed nightly jobs for Cygnus customers from 14:05–14:40 UTC. Action: postmortem + alerting tweak"

acct-jamila: Customer email sent with offer to re-run failed jobs; Cygnus replied: "Thanks — please re-run nightly jobs and confirm once done." Passing to ops to schedule.

docs-ryan: I'll file the incident stub and create a postmortem template with assigned owners: eng-runtime for root cause, sre for monitoring guard, acct for customer follow-up.

sre-oncall-ben: thanks all. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
